title: Settings Reference | ContextMint Docs
description: Complete ContextMint settings — VS Code extension (contextmint.*) and API server (contextmint.defaults.yaml), with defaults, usage guides, and rollout notes.

narration.title: Evidence narration & clarification
narration.intro: Controls citation-bound LLM narration on sanitized excerpts, clarification recovery when evidence is insufficient, and the final honest stop after max clarification turns. See master plan §6.1 in documentation/CONTEXTMINT-EVIDENCE-NARRATION-MASTER-PLAN.md.

retrieval.title: Retrieval / tracing (manual UAT)
retrieval.intro: Decision audit for repo-lane structural turns — ordered steps with inputs, outputs, and reasons. Export writes retrieval-trace-*.json under the operator-configured folder (retrieval.trace_export_dir, default documentation/evidence). Path is never hardcoded in product code. Pair with context-receipt-*.json from the same folder. See master plan §6.1b (Retrieval & evidence decision trace) in documentation/CONTEXTMINT-EVIDENCE-NARRATION-MASTER-PLAN.md.

liveProgress.title: Live pipeline progress (SSE)
liveProgress.intro: Optional real-time pipeline_progress SSE events during chat retrieval so the VS Code extension live timeline can show what the server is doing while the user waits. Off by default until RT-VIEW dogfood. Enable retrieval.live_progress_enabled on the API host — the extension renders events when the server emits them (no separate extension toggle). See documentation/REALTIME-SERVER-VIEW-EXTENSION-PLAN.md and documentation/IC-PAUSE-UX-RT-VIEW-ARCHITECTURE-PLAN.md.
